title: Master-detail page
summary: Static slotted mode (for server-rendered, JavaScript-optional sites): write your own list as a child in slot="list" (a pk-side-nav of links, a plain list) and the record as a child in slot="detail", with no config.list. The page lays them out as written (side by side wide; one pane at a time on a phone: the list, or the record when you wrote record-id), takes the current row from your own markup (aria-current / current), and never creates, moves or changes your elements; load, open, close, mountDetail and config do nothing, and the record keeps its own back link. A list or record is real markup even without JavaScript. Dynamic mode: A list of records and the record the route selected. Wide, they sit side by side (a pk-list-page and the record pane); narrow, one shows at a time and the record has a Back button. The host owns the selection: set recordId from the route (a deep link works), and the element reports what the reader did through callback properties. load(query) feeds the list exactly as pk-list-page's does; open(row) is called when a row is chosen and close() when Back is pressed, so the host changes the route. mountDetail(pane, id) draws the record into the pane and returns a cleanup function or a { destroy() } handle, called when the record changes or the element leaves the page. While mountDetail is pending the built-in loading state shows over the record, a rejection shows the error state with Retry. Focus moves to the record once it is drawn, and back to the row that was open when the selection clears.

props.name: config
props.description: { list?, backLabel?, none?, label? }. pk-page-header title bar keys: badges [{ label, variant? }], actionsOverflow, overflowLabel, homeHref, homeLabel, homeIcon. list is pk-list-page's own config ({ columns, filters?, actions?, empty?, pageSize? }). backLabel is the Back button's text (default 'Back'). none is { heading?, description? } shown in the record pane while nothing is selected. label names the loading state. Optional title bar from the shared page shell: heading?: string, breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }], actions?: [{ key, label, href?, variant?, hint? }] (a hint shows as a tooltip on the button) (an action without href fires pk-action). Nothing is drawn when none is set.

props.name: recordId
props.description: The id of the selected record, from the route; empty when none is. Untrusted text: it is only passed to mountDetail.

props.name: fill
props.description: Take all the room a flex column parent leaves.

slots.name: list
slots.description: Static slotted mode: your own list of records (a pk-side-nav, a plain list of links), shown as written; its presence with no config.list selects the mode, decided when the element connects.

slots.name: detail
slots.description: The record (mountDetail not set), shown only while recordId is set. Static slotted mode: your own record markup, shown as written; on a phone it shows instead of the list while record-id is set.

events.name: pk-action
events.description: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-header with the breadcrumb and actions from config. Hidden when config sets none of them.

parts.name: detail
parts.description: The record pane (focused once its record is drawn).

parts.name: back
parts.description: The Back button; shown only when one pane shows at a time.

parts.name: record
parts.description: The record's content; mountDetail draws into it.

parts.name: state
parts.description: Shows the loading or error state in place of the record.

a11y: The list keeps pk-list-page's table, filter and pagination semantics. The record pane is focusable and takes focus when a record opens, so a keyboard or screen reader user lands on it; Back returns focus to the row that was open. The loading and error states use pk-skeleton and pk-alert's own roles.
